Bill.BriefDescription: Containing costs for services to sexually violent predators.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to containing costs for services to sexuallyviolent predators; and amending RCW 71.09.110 and 71.09.800.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 71.09.110 and 1995 c 216 s 14 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of social and health services shall be responsiblefor all costs relating to the evaluation and treatment of personscommitted to their custody whether in a secure facility or under a lessrestrictive alternative under any provision of this chapter. Thesecretary shall adopt rules for the reimbursement of costs relating toevaluations by experts. Reimbursement may be obtained by thedepartment for the cost of care and treatment of persons committed toits custody whether in a secure facility or under a less restrictivealternative pursuant to RCW 43.20B.330 through 43.20B.370.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 71.09.800 and 2000 c 44 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary shall adopt rules under the administrative procedureact, chapter 34.05 RCW, for the oversight and operation of the program p. 1 HB 3198established pursuant to this chapter. Such rules shall includeprovisions for an annual inspection of the special commitment center,reimbursement of costs related to evaluations by experts, andrequirements for treatment plans and the retention of records.
